name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with no glow. This guarantees visibility on every background without adding visual noise that could distract users with reduced motion or cognitive load. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but it eliminates the risk of the glow blending into backgrounds or failing on low-contrast surfaces.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast still fails on patterned or high-contrast backgrounds—users with low vision or cognitive disabilities will miss it. Instead, use a 2px ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 2px inner glow at 20% opacity; this ensures visibility on all backgrounds while keeping the focus indicator unobtrusive. Test with real users on patterned backgrounds to settle it.

The trade-off is slightly lower contrast on solid backgrounds, but it ensures no user misses the focus state.

name: Reader
text: A 2px ring with 20% inner glow risks disappearing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds—users with low vision or cognitive disabilities will still miss it. Instead, use a 3px ring at 6:1 contrast with a 1px inner glow at 10% opacity; this ensures visibility on all backgrounds while keeping the indicator subtle and motion-safe. Settle it with user testing on patterned backgrounds and motion-sensitive users.

name: Access
